name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a lifelong passion for racing, but through a deep fascination with the intricate data networks that underpin modern racing operations. After graduating with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Belgrade, he worked for several years in the financial sector, honing his skills in managing complex IT infrastructures. He then made a career change to motorsport, seeing an opportunity to apply his expertise in a high-pressure, dynamic environment. 

At Aston Martin, Nikola is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of all IT systems, from race simulations and data analysis tools to the team's communication networks. He takes a practical approach to problem-solving, prioritizing stability and reliability above all else. He is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues, even under immense pressure. His calm demeanor and logical approach make him a valuable asset to the team, especially during race weekends.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong black coffee.
